provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^315 - 1 with a(x) = x^3 + x^79 + x^116 + x^167 + x^231 + x^250 + x^281, b(x) = x^0 + x^18 + x^62 + x^64 + x^78 + x^87 + x^123 + x^139 + x^157 + x^158 + x^171 + x^190 + x^219 + x^300 + x^313; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
